study: Readiness of the most-visited EU-domain websites for EN 301 549 V4.1.1

method.selection: Domains with an EU member state TLD, in Tranco rank order
method.countedWhen: the criterion failed on both loads

namingPolicy: Per-site rows carry a rank bucket and TLD, never the domain. The sample can be reconstructed exactly from the Tranco list id and the selection rule, so anyone can rebuild it and re-run; we decline to publish the list of names ourselves, because a vendor that sells the remedy naming the sites turns a measurement into an accusation.

consent.note: Consent dialogs were never dismissed. Sites showing one were measured as an uninvited visitor sees them, which is also how a regulator arrives.

instability.note: Two loads of the same page, seconds apart, produced different findings on these sites. Nothing was fixed in between. It is the reason a dated one-off audit describes a moment rather than a site.
